description: Shared education presentation layer for narrative framing and world-sim templates. This pack is cosmetic only and does not own learning, wellness, or governance physics.

invariants.description: Presentation assets must not change domain physics, standing-order selection, escalation thresholds, or learner state transitions.
Narrative framing must preserve magic-circle consent and must not obscure the real educational task or responsible authority.

standing_orders.description: Stop any presentation-layer attempt to alter department physics and route to the owning department authority.
Ask the author to restate how the presentation keeps consent and real-world task boundaries clear.

escalation_triggers.condition: A world-sim or presentation artifact attempts to override department logic or consent boundaries.
